cards.title: Keep a mutable object in a constant binding
cards.explanation: Keep the object identity while updating its visit count.

cards.title: Normalize a numeric form field before comparison
cards.explanation: Reject blank and nonnumeric input explicitly, then compare numbers.

cards.title: Update a profile without mutating the original
cards.explanation: Create a shallow copy with a normalized name. Nested objects still share identity.

cards.title: Separate a task title from its remaining fields
cards.explanation: Extract a display value while keeping the other task fields.

cards.title: Find active task names in a stable order
cards.explanation: Filter completed tasks before transforming the remaining items.

cards.title: Skip inactive work and stop at a limit
cards.explanation: Select at most the requested number of unfinished tasks.

cards.title: Create independent counters with captured state
cards.explanation: Each call owns a different count binding.

cards.title: Export a reusable text helper
cards.explanation: Import slug from this module; no TypeScript compiler is required.

cards.title: Display an optional profile name
cards.explanation: Use the fallback only when the profile or its name is missing.

cards.title: Collect successful async results and report failures
cards.explanation: Capture synchronous throws from loaders as well as promise rejections.

cards.title: Return a useful error when JSON is invalid
cards.explanation: Preserve the cause while exposing a task-specific message.

cards.title: Format a task using a template expression
cards.explanation: Interpolate an expression without concatenation. Use textContent when displaying untrusted text.

cards.title: Count task categories with a Map
cards.explanation: Accumulate counts without object prototype-key collisions.

cards.title: Encapsulate a balance with a private class field
cards.explanation: Validate deposits before changing private state.

cards.title: Attach a click handler and remove it later
cards.explanation: Return a cleanup function so the caller can stop observing clicks.

cards.title: Cancel a pending JSON request
cards.explanation: The caller owns cancellation and must handle result rejection, including AbortError.

cards.title: Read a UTF-8 file in Node
cards.explanation: Read a caller-provided local file; no hardcoded path or external service.

cards.title: Render a component with props and children
cards.explanation: Compose a panel with supplied content rather than calling the component as a normal function.

cards.title: Read an input from a change handler
cards.explanation: Keep input state controlled and type the extracted event handler in TSX.

cards.title: Count clicks with a functional state update
cards.explanation: Queue an update based on the previous count, with an optional typed label in TSX.

cards.title: Render keyed tasks with a conditional empty state
cards.explanation: Use fragments, expressions, stable keys and a visible empty state.

cards.title: Subscribe to window events with effect cleanup
cards.explanation: Subscribe once, remove the same handler on cleanup, and render the measured width.

cards.title: Abort a stale request when a component changes
cards.explanation: Handle HTTP errors and cancellation without allowing an old request to replace the new result.

cards.title: Focus an input through a DOM ref
cards.explanation: Guard the nullable element reference and specify its DOM type in TSX.

cards.title: Validate JSON before accepting a task
cards.explanation: Express 5: export the app for local request tests; listen only in the launcher.

cards.title: Handle a rejected Express route in error middleware
cards.explanation: Keep private error details out of the response; Express 4 requires explicit async forwarding.

cards.title: Test a synchronous result and async rejection
cards.explanation: Run this file through Vitest; it registers a test rather than executing on import.

cards.title: Test a React interaction through its accessible role
cards.explanation: Use a DOM test environment (jsdom), React and Testing Library with Vitest.

cards.title: Total a variable number of invoice lines
cards.explanation: ESM export; pass tax as a fraction followed by amounts. Empty prices total zero. Floating point is illustrative; use integer minor units for money.

cards.title: Build a reusable named function expression
cards.explanation: ESM; returns a closure for later callbacks. An empty label is preserved, undefined uses the default, and null is rejected.

cards.title: Keep a counter receiver in a DOM event callback
cards.explanation: Pass a DOM button and makeClickCounter() result. Passing counter.increment directly would update the button receiver instead. Call the returned cleanup on teardown.

cards.title: Apply one invoice method to different receivers
cards.explanation: ESM; amounts is an iterable array of finite numbers. call spreads arguments, apply accepts an array-like list, bind partially applies a discount.

cards.title: Snapshot nested settings without changing live state
cards.explanation: Pass structured-cloneable data, including nested objects and cycles. A function in the graph throws DataCloneError; class prototypes are not retained.

cards.title: Inspect which parts of a shallow update are shared
cards.explanation: Pass an account object and string name. The returned account is new but preferences has shared identity; use an explicit nested copy before changing preferences.

cards.title: Read an own setting before falling back to defaults
cards.explanation: ESM; own undefined is an explicit value, not absence. Inherited keys must not override the caller-supplied fallback.

cards.title: Count arbitrary tags without prototype collisions
cards.explanation: ESM; iterable of strings. Keys such as __proto__ and constructor are ordinary dictionary entries; Object.entries excludes inherited data.

cards.title: Keep a request token out of JSON enumeration
cards.explanation: ESM strict mode; token is readable but neither enumerable nor writable/configurable. This is serialization control, not a security boundary.

cards.title: Expose a computed stock value with validated writes
cards.explanation: ESM; uses a closure-backed accessor. Rejected writes preserve the prior stock value. Zero is a valid boundary.

cards.title: Normalize and deduplicate notification recipients
cards.explanation: ESM; trims/lowercases identifiers under an application policy, not full email address canonicalization. Blanks are omitted.

cards.title: Find required permissions that were not granted
cards.explanation: ESM; permission keys should be strings. Returns deduplicated missing keys in required order, including an empty result when all are granted.

cards.title: Cache expensive labels by object identity
cards.explanation: ESM; format is a synchronous function. Mutable objects need explicit invalidation or a different cache policy. Even an undefined result is cached.

cards.title: Attach and remove transient validation errors
cards.explanation: ESM; field can be a DOM element or another object. Explicit clear removes obsolete metadata without relying on garbage collection.

cards.title: Process a stream of items in bounded batches
cards.explanation: ESM; accepts a synchronous iterable and yields arrays lazily, including a final short batch. Validation happens on first iteration.

cards.title: Close a line source when a search stops early
cards.explanation: ESM; source has a synchronous lines iterable and close() method. Early break and thrown input errors both close the source. Opening the source is the caller responsibility.

cards.title: Make a reusable iterable of page numbers
cards.explanation: ESM; each iteration starts a new generator. Count zero is empty; the bound prevents accidental enormous iteration.

cards.title: Define explicit text and numeric conversion for a quantity
cards.explanation: ESM; String(quantity) includes a unit, Number(quantity) returns its numeric value. The default hint uses the numeric policy.

cards.title: Extract ticket numbers with named captures
cards.explanation: ESM; matches ASCII TASK identifiers in free text, not a validation grammar. No matches returns []; captured digit strings preserve leading zeroes and arbitrary integer precision.

cards.title: Search user text as a literal regular expression
cards.explanation: ESM; escapes regex metacharacters rather than interpreting the query. This example intentionally uses a portable escape recipe instead of newer RegExp.escape.

cards.title: Truncate a display label without splitting emoji
cards.explanation: ESM; Node 26/Chromium with Intl.Segmenter. Limit zero is empty; this function does not append an ellipsis. It segments the complete label in memory.

cards.title: Compare canonically equivalent usernames
cards.explanation: ESM; compares case-sensitively after canonical normalization. This does not handle visual confusables or implement authentication policy.

cards.title: Increment a sequence number without losing precision
cards.explanation: ESM; zero and negative zero are accepted as the starting sequence. The last safe integer cannot be incremented safely.

cards.title: Sum integer minor units exactly and serialize as text
cards.explanation: ESM; accepts signed integer strings, not decimal currency amounts. Returns a JSON-safe string to retain precision across transports.

cards.title: Read a validated retry policy from JSON
cards.explanation: ESM; strips unknown fields by returning a new domain value. Returns a tagged error for malformed syntax and invalid domain data, including null.

cards.title: Report JSON export failures without hiding them
cards.explanation: ESM; callers must inspect ok. Cycles, BigInt and a root undefined are errors; ordinary JSON omission rules still apply inside objects.

cards.title: Report every batch job without losing synchronous failures
cards.explanation: ESM; jobs is an array of zero-argument functions. Results retain input order, including a synchronous throw, and an empty batch returns [].

cards.title: Require both local resources and choose the first available mirror
cards.explanation: ESM; jobs are functions that produce promises or values. firstMirror accepts the first settlement, including rejection; it is not Promise.any and does not cancel losers. Use abort-lifetime for owned cancellation.

cards.title: Observe stack, microtask and timer order
cards.explanation: ESM; asserts ordering, not elapsed milliseconds. No Node-specific nextTick or I/O phase assumptions are needed.

cards.title: Batch synchronous invalidations into one microtask
cards.explanation: ESM; flush and onError are synchronous callbacks. Failures go to onError and the queue can be used again; asynchronous rejections need their own handling.

cards.title: Cancel a delay and release its timer and listener
cards.explanation: ESM; pass an AbortSignal and finite nonnegative delay. Both timer completion and abort release resources; zero still schedules a later task. Delays must be at most 2147483647 ms to avoid timer overflow/clamping.

cards.title: Bound an owned fetch and always clear its timeout
cards.explanation: ESM; default fetch is Node/Chromium Fetch. Inject a local transport for tests. Timeout covers response JSON parsing; HTTP and malformed JSON errors propagate. Native fetch observes the owned signal. Delays must be at most 2147483647 ms to avoid timer overflow/clamping.

cards.title: Round-trip a local filename through a file URL
cards.explanation: Node 26 ESM; accepts an OS filename, including spaces and #. Does not read a file or check whether it exists.

cards.title: Reject lexical path escapes from a fixture folder
cards.explanation: Node 26 ESM; for disposable fixtures with no untrusted symlinks. Allows normalized nested paths but rejects the root itself; not a production file-serving sandbox.

cards.title: Validate and submit a named email field
cards.explanation: Chromium DOM; form contains an input name=email type=email required and an output element. save is synchronous; asynchronous persistence needs an async status contract. Returns cleanup.

cards.title: Read a bounded integer field with missing-data errors
cards.explanation: Chromium DOM; a named quantity control is required. Accepts zero and leading zeroes, rejects decimals, Files, disabled/missing controls and values above 100.

cards.title: Recover a theme from missing or malformed local storage
cards.explanation: Chromium origin with storage; injected getter can model blocked access. Missing, invalid JSON and unsupported themes recover to system.

cards.title: Report a failed preference write without losing the choice
cards.explanation: Chromium origin; caller retains the requested display theme even when storage is blocked/full. Validation errors are distinct from persistence failure.

cards.title: Delegate remove buttons in a changing list
cards.explanation: Chromium DOM; use button data-id children. remove is synchronous application logic; nested spans and dynamically inserted buttons work. Returns cleanup.

cards.title: Delegate accessible tab selection with a roving tab stop
cards.explanation: Chromium DOM; click/activation portion of a tabs widget, not a complete keyboard tab implementation. Use native buttons and add arrow-key/panel behavior for production tabs.

cards.title: Update cart quantities with a pure bounded reducer
cards.explanation: React 19.3.1 + JSX transform. Pure reducer enforces the same bound as the UI; a disabled button prevents accidental invalid clicks.

cards.title: Implement undo with immutable reducer history
cards.explanation: React 19.3.1 + JSX; keeps full prior strings for a small form, not a bounded production history. Undo at the initial state is a safe no-op.

cards.title: Render a theme with a safe missing-provider default
cards.explanation: React 19.3.1 + JSX. ThemeContext.Provider may supply light/dark/system; absence uses system, invalid explicit values throw.

cards.title: Require a project provider before rendering its name
cards.explanation: React 19.3.1 + JSX. Surround ProjectName with ProjectContext.Provider value={{name}}. Throws a clear configuration error for missing/malformed providers.

cards.title: Submit a name with an announced validation error
cards.explanation: React 19.3.1 + JSX; save returns a promise or value. This small example handles rejection/retry; disable submission or sequence requests if concurrent saves are possible.

cards.title: Require consent with a native labelled checkbox
cards.explanation: React 19.3.1 + JSX; subscribe is synchronous. Native checkbox keyboard behavior and a real label are retained. No subscription is sent by the playground.

cards.title: Validate task JSON and preserve parser error statuses
cards.explanation: Express 5.3.0 ESM; app is exported, does not listen until the caller chooses a local port. Empty/oversize titles are rejected; parser errors have a separate stable contract.

cards.title: Forward async repository failures and distinguish missing tasks
cards.explanation: Express 5.3.0 ESM; injected asynchronous repository uses string IDs, avoiding unsafe numeric conversion. No database or external service is required.

cards.title: Assert a debounced callback and restore fake timers
cards.explanation: Vitest 5.0.4 ESM test module; run with Vitest, not direct Node import. Asserts happy delivery, the boundary before the deadline and cancellation.

cards.title: Assert async DOM output and a rejected load
cards.explanation: Vitest 5.0.4 + Testing Library React 16.3.0/jsdom 30.1.2; exact test module. Local injected loads exercise empty output, success and rejection; no network requests.

cards.title: Index records and reject duplicate keys
cards.explanation: ESM; iterable of records with stable id keys. Map supports arbitrary keys and preserves insertion order; duplicate identities are rejected rather than silently replaced.

cards.title: Read module-relative JSON and reject invalid settings
cards.explanation: Node 26 ESM; pass a file URL such as new URL("./settings.json", import.meta.url). Missing files, malformed JSON and invalid domain data reject distinctly; readFile manages file closure.
